types.name: Codalyzer
types.summary: Provides an abstract base class for generating and managing code files, including properties, functions, and interfaces.
types.remarks:
The Code.Codalyzer class is designed to facilitate the creation of structured code
files with support for namespaces, classes, properties, functions, and interfaces. It provides methods for adding
code elements, managing file content, and saving the generated code to a specified file path. Derived classes

directives are included, handles namespace declarations, and writes the class definition with appropriate
inheritance and members. If the target file is marked as auto-generated, a corresponding comment is added at
the top of the file.

members.name: Filter
members.summary: Determines whether the specified text should be excluded based on the defined filters, include, and exclude lists.
members.remarks:
The method evaluates the text against three criteria: If the text does not match any of the filters, it is excluded.If the text is present in the exclude list, it is excluded.If the text is present in the include list, it is explicitly included, overriding other
criteria. The filters, include, and exclude lists are defined as delimited
strings and are split using the FilterHelper.FilterSeperator.
members.returns:
true if the text should be excluded based on the filters and exclude list; otherwise, false
if the text is explicitly included or does not match exclusion criteria.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: The text to evaluate against the filters.

actions associated with hooks.

The action to execute when the hook is triggered. The action receives an object parameter containing
hook-specific data. Cannot be null.

action does not exist, the method has no effect.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The action associated with the hook to remove. This cannot be null.

members.summary: Moves the camera by a distance in viewer units, e.g. for keyboard navigation.

members.name: Pan
members.signature: public void Pan(double screenDeltaX, double screenDeltaY)
members.summary: Drags the world by a pointer movement in viewer units, so the point under the pointer follows it.

members.name: ZoomAt
members.signature: public void ZoomAt(double screenX, double screenY, double factor)
members.summary: Multiplies the zoom by a factor while keeping the world point under a viewer position in place.

members.name: SetZoomAt
members.signature: public void SetZoomAt(double screenX, double screenY, double zoom)
members.summary: Sets the zoom while keeping the world point under a viewer position in place.

members.name: CenterOn
members.signature: public void CenterOn(double worldX, double worldY, double viewWidth, double viewHeight)
members.summary: Centers a world position in a viewer of the specified size, keeping the zoom.

members.name: Frame
members.signature: public void Frame(double worldX, double worldY, double width, double height, double viewWidth, double viewHeight, double margin = 0,1)
members.summary:
Centers a world area in a viewer of the specified size and zooms out if needed so the whole area is visible,
leaving a margin (as a fraction of the viewer) around it. The zoom is never increased beyond 1.

members.name: Reset
members.summary: Moves the camera back to the world origin with a zoom of 1.

members.name: Set
members.signature: public void Set(double x, double y, double zoom)
members.summary: Sets the position (the world point at the top-left of the viewer) and the zoom.

members.name: Changed
members.summary: Raised whenever the position or zoom changes.

members.name: MinZoom
members.summary: The smallest allowed zoom.

members.name: MaxZoom
members.summary: The largest allowed zoom.

members.name: DefaultSpeed
members.summary: The default keyboard navigation speed, in viewer units per second.

members.name: MinSpeed
members.summary: The smallest allowed keyboard navigation speed.

members.name: MaxSpeed
members.summary: The largest allowed keyboard navigation speed.

View model for a single property shown in the properties panel. Derive from it to adapt a property value
to what a Data.IPropertyDefinition template binds to.
